daily.full:
共識

共同看好最齊的是$WMT，2好0淡。@Mr_Derivatives指出它再度展現防守特性，今天報121美元，過去7週反彈理想（原帖）。@OptionsMike提到今天並不容易，但$XLF、$WMT及$COST表現強勁，債券因避險需求大升，AI交易受挫，下週將是重要指標（原帖）。

共同看淡

$MRNA 0好3淡，4次提及。@RichardMoglen指出它跌破（原帖）。@APompliano提到兩天前@MunchingMoez提出做空Moderna的論點，今天下跌近20%（原帖）。@ripster47說在數據外洩後出現利好出盡，現跌20%（原帖）。

$QQQ也是0好2淡。@bespokeinvest看到它跌至日內低位，下跌2.8%，已完全回吐9月16日至10月6日的7.8%升幅（原帖）。@spotgamma指出輪動交易持續，醫療、住宅建築、零售及金融股上漲，$QQQ跌2%或以上，$RSP持平或上升（原帖）。

分歧

$SPCX 1好2淡。@StockSavvyShay提供完整分析，說明為何盈利給他信心買入這波AI拋售（原帖）。但@ripster47稱在MTF下方為穩健的第二天盈利空頭，屬可操作設定（原帖），@RichardMoglen表示市場對它說「不」（原帖）。

其他值得留意

數據範圍是今日48則帖文（44原創、4轉發）、21個帳號，看好18對看淡12，清晰觀點帳號16個。最多人講是$RSP（5次提及、5個帳號），反映資金輪動到更廣闊市場。以上只整理公開帖文觀點，非投資建議。

daily.brief: Today’s 48 posts from 21 accounts show 18 bullish views versus 12 bearish. Joint bullish is limited to $WMT showing defensive traits, while $MRNA dropped nearly 20% after data leak as joint bearish focus. $SPCX is split, and $RSP has the most mentions reflecting rotation.
daily.full:
Consensus

Strongest joint bullish is $WMT, 2 bulls 0 bears. @Mr_Derivatives noted it again showed defensive characteristics, trading at $121 today with a solid rebound over the past 7 weeks (post). @OptionsMike said today was not easy, but $XLF, $WMT and $COST performed strongly as bonds rose on hedging demand and AI trades struggled (post).

Joint bearish

$MRNA is 0 bulls 3 bears. @RichardMoglen pointed out the breakdown (post). @APompliano noted that two days ago @MunchingMoez laid out a short thesis on Moderna, and today it fell nearly 20% (post). @ripster47 called it a sell-the-news after the data leak, now down 20% (post).

$QQQ is also 0 bulls 2 bears. @bespokeinvest saw it hit the intraday low, down 2.8%, fully giving back the 7.8% gain from Sep 16 to Oct 6 (post). @spotgamma highlighted ongoing rotation with healthcare, homebuilders, retail and financials up while $QQQ fell 2% or more and $RSP was flat or up (post).

Splits

$SPCX is 1 bull 2 bears. @StockSavvyShay provided a full analysis on why the earnings gave him confidence to buy this AI selloff (post). But @ripster47 called it a solid day-2 profitable short below MTF, a workable setup (post), and @RichardMoglen said the market told it “no” (post).

Other notes

Data range is today’s 48 posts (44 originals, 4 reposts) from 21 accounts, 18 bullish vs 12 bearish, 16 clear-view accounts. Most talked about is $RSP (5 mentions, 5 accounts), reflecting rotation into broader markets. This only organizes public post views, not investment advice.

daily.full:
합의

공동 약세

$MRNA는 0강 3약. @RichardMoglen은 하방 돌파를 지적 (원문). @APompliano는 이틀 전 @MunchingMoez가 Moderna 공매도 논점을 제시했고 오늘 약 20% 하락했다고 언급 (원문). @ripster47은 데이터 유출 후 호재 소진으로 현재 20% 하락이라고 함 (원문).

$QQQ도 0강 2약. @bespokeinvest는 장중 저점까지 하락해 2.8% 떨어지고 9월 16일부터 10월 6일까지 7.8% 상승분을 완전히 반납했다고 봄 (원문). @spotgamma는 헬스케어, 주택건설, 소매, 금융주가 상승하는 로테이션이 지속되고 $QQQ는 2% 이상 하락, $RSP는 보합 또는 상승이라고 지적 (원문).

분열

$SPCX는 1강 2약. @StockSavvyShay는 실적이 AI 매도세에 매수 확신을 준 이유를 전체 분석으로 제시 (원문). 그러나 @ripster47은 MTF 아래의 견고한 2일차 수익 공매도 설정이라고 했고 (원문), @RichardMoglen은 시장이 "아니오"라고 했다고 함 (원문).

briefing.html:
오늘 시장 스냅샷

48개 게시물, 21개 계정, 강세 18 대 약세 12. 공동 강세는 $WMT의 방어적 특성, $121에 지난 7주 견고한 반등. 공동 약세 초점은 $MRNA, 데이터 유출 후 호재 소진으로 약 20% 하락. $SPCX는 매수와 공매도 설정이 공존, $QQQ는 상승분 반납으로 로테이션 반영. 투자 조언 아님.
